caption: The drawing depicts a full-length gown displayed on a faceless mannequin. The gown is primarily light cream or off-white in color and features a fitted bodice with a wide, rounded neckline edged by a ruffle trim. The sleeves are long and slightly flared at the cuffs, ending in elaborate ruffled lace with a bow at each wrist. The bodice and upper parts of the sleeves are decorated with small pink floral motifs. The skirt is wide and voluminous, extending outward at the hips and narrowing slightly towards the hem. The front of the skirt and panniers is elaborately embroidered with symmetrical patterns, including curved brown lines that form scalloped shapes enclosing pale green leaves and interspersed with pink and blue floral designs. Central to the front skirt panel is a bouquet of flowers in green, pink, and brown, flanked on either side by more small floral decorations. The hem of the skirt is bordered by a band of ruffles and pastel flowers. The drawing uses fine lines for contour and detail, and the colors are soft and pastel, dominated by creams, light blues, pinks, greens, and browns. The background is a plain, light beige tone.
title: Dress
